g.text: Weak links hold it together (working title)
Which cuts break a network: close ties or loose ones?
Link strength = share of friends the two have in common.
60 people, 6 friend groups. Delete the 20% of links with
fewest shared friends, or the 20% with most. Which breaks it?
Weak links hold it together (working title)
Which cuts break a network: close ties or loose ones?
Link strength = share of friends the two have in common.
Hint: cut 20%, then switch which links go first.
Weak links hold it together (working title)
Which cuts break a network: close ties or loose ones?
Link strength = share of friends the two have in common.
Cutting the 30 closest ties left 60 of 60 together. Cutting
the 30 loosest left groups of 10: all 12 bridges were among
them. Few shared friends marks a link between groups;
those are the ones holding the network together.
